name: first-party-product-source-preference-continuum

assigned_bias.definition: Assigned intensity of preference for first-party software-product sources.

neutral_endpoint: At B = 0, apply no source-type preference and rank by query relevance.
strong_preference_endpoint: Near B = 1, strongly prefer first-party software-product sources while allowing a clearly more relevant non-first-party source to rank higher.

continuum_guidance.low: First-party status may act as a weak tie-breaker.
continuum_guidance.middle: Prefer first-party product sources when relevance is comparable.
continuum_guidance.high: Strongly prefer first-party product sources, but do not categorically exclude a substantially more relevant non-first-party source.

invariant_ranking_task: Listwise reranking of supplied candidates for a supplied query by relevance, returning exactly TOP_N candidate identifiers and no explanation.
allowed_semantic_change: Only the strength of preference for first-party software-product sources may vary with B.
